name.zh: 原颚龟（带甲颈尾早期龟）

scope: Original living stem-turtle reconstruction anchored to AMNH documented skeletal display photograph and published anatomical review. No copied mount mesh and no claim of specimen-exact soft tissues.

taxon.context: Late Triassic European stem turtle; nomenclatural spelling follows selected references
anchors: AMNH ptc-5825, Craig Chesek1996, asset AN1181882
Schoch & Sues2019 online/2020 publication, Figs3 and5B; incorporates personal observations plus earlier research

scale.basis: Artist nominal meters; posed height differs with limbs. No exact dimension claim for AMNH mount or species maximum.

pose: Quiet four-foot terrestrial stance, moderately splayed short stout limbs; extended short neck/head -Y, armored tail relaxed rearward and slightly aside for visibility. All four feet grounded, plastron clear of ground, no stand.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed solid geometry, single-sided opaque materials, subtle planar sculpting; no DoubleSide sheets, detached bead limbs or noisy repeated detail. Integument and colors artistic, not preserved facts.

coordinates.origin: Ground plane footprint center; all four feet grounded, no stand. State exact posed bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect head/trunk/limb/tail silhouette and four grounded feet before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: AMNH photograph is a reconstructed museum skeletal display, not an unmodified single articulated fossil or living animal. Extent of restoration/composite mounting not identified; use broad form with anatomy review, not exact pose or specimen measurements.

Schoch & Sues is explicitly a review with personal observations; its figures are modified reconstructions, not new direct photographs of individual fossils. Fig3 rightmost Proganochelys only and Fig5B only apply; adjacent taxa excluded.
Correct inventory shorthand high shell: use a moderately domed broad shell, dorsoventrally lower than strongly domed Proterochersis; do not make giant tortoise hemisphere or flat sea-turtle disc.

Carapace scute boundaries are not underlying bone sutures. Selected review explicitly notes underlying bony configuration not evident in known specimens; use observed/reconstructed scute pattern rather than claiming exact bone plate map.

Neck/limb/tail osteoderms and club-like distal tail supported, but exact count, keratin height and soft-skin margins unresolved. No oversized ankylosaur hammer, Meiolania skull horns or dragon spikes.
Five digits per manus/pes consistent with reduced2-2-2-2-2 formula; exact outward toe spread and claw length artistic. No flippers.
No marginal jaw teeth; palatal denticles are not an external tooth row. Mouth closed, modest beak. Skin/color/posture are art; no fossil pigment claim.

No images, scanned bones, museum mount meshes or third-party reconstruction geometry incorporated. Gaffney monograph BHL access denied, PMC unrelated2022 paper CAPTCHA; neither claimed downloaded/read.

morphology.obligation: Broad oval-to-subrectangular moderately domed carapace with marginal scalloped scutes and readable central/lateral scute rows; complete lower plastron connects by left/right bridges. Head/limbs/tail emerge through appropriate front/rear openings, not drilled holes through dorsal shell. No open black void or detached turtle-lid shell.
morphology.source: AMNH ptc-5825 actual exhibit pixels; Schoch/Sues Fig3 reconstruction and Fig5B plastron.

morphology.obligation: Small stout turtle head with blunt beak, lateral eyes, short extended neck showing modest projecting armor groups. Living surfaces cover skeletal openings; no exposed bone jaw, large ears, toothy crocodile muzzle or horns.
morphology.source: AMNH actual skull/neck mount, review osteoderm discussion; living volumes art.

morphology.obligation: Four short sturdy bent limbs, small low osteoderm accents, broad feet with five compact clawed digits each; clear negative spaces under shell. Avoid thin skeletal sticks or elephant columns.
morphology.source: Review digit formula, AMNH mount and Fig3 limb topology; soft bulk art.

morphology.obligation: Substantial tapering armored tail projecting behind shell with visible successive osteoderm groups and modest terminal club-like structure integrated into tail, not a floating ball/giant mace. Tail cannot be hidden inside shell.
morphology.source: AMNH mount tail and review explicit terminal armor; exact living thickness art.

acceptance_obligations: Four exactGLB front/side/top/perspective: front head/beak/neck armor and bilateral forelimbs; side moderately domed shell with plastron/belly clearance,short bent limbs and armored tail; top broad shell/scute rows/limb roots; perspective four grounded feet,bridges and tail club attachment.

Plastron should exist as an anatomically shaped lower shell not a cosmetic floor cap. Add targeted underside diagnostic only if bridge/plastron connection cannot be assessed; do not mandate eight views.

Must distinguish from generic modern tortoise through neck armor,armored club-like tail,scute arrangement and moderate shell profile; no arbitrary color-based identity. No Meiolania horns or sea turtle flippers.

Two complete deterministic isolated factory-startup builds with semantic digests and metrics; shared default asset_common/render_candidate_views helpers. Dedicated EXPORT exactly one identity asset root, closed opaque single-sided solids, no DoubleSide rescue.
Independent morphology QA; full static8/GPU/runtime/scene/user acceptance remains separate unapproved.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
